tagline: Mission-driven European healthcare provider specializing in elderly care, rehabilitation clinics, and home hospitalization
hero_kpi_rationale: The HAD segment displays remarkable growth of 25% in patients, becoming the primary driver of organic growth and reflecting a strategic transformation toward home-based care, a major structural trend in European healthcare.

kpis.name: HAD patient growth
kpis.explanation: Change in the number of patients followed in home hospitalization.
kpis.description: HAD displays very strong growth (+25%), driven by the acquisition of HAD Saint-Sauveur in June 2024 and the ramp-up of home-based care services.
kpis.signal: WOW: +25% HAD patient growth, key growth driver

kpis.name: Organic revenue growth
kpis.explanation: Revenue growth excluding acquisition and reclassification effects.
kpis.description: Adjusted organic growth reached +6.7% in 2024, continuing a trajectory above 5% since 2021.

kpis.name: Operating EBITDA margin
kpis.explanation: Operating EBITDA divided by operating revenue.
kpis.description: Operating EBITDA margin declined to 18.4% in 2024 due to SMR tariff reform and inflation underfunding.
kpis.signal: Margin under pressure but resilient (-142 bps)

kpis.name: Operating revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from care and accommodation activities.
kpis.description: Operating revenue reached €793.9M in 2024, up +10.3% reported, +6.7% adjusted organic.

kpis.name: Consolidated net financial debt
kpis.explanation: Total financial debt less cash and cash equivalents, for the consolidated group.
kpis.description: Consolidated net financial debt stood at €377.7M in 2024, up +3.0%, despite a reduction in operating net debt.
kpis.signal: Consolidated net debt at €377.7M, slight increase of +3%

kpis.name: Operating leverage
kpis.explanation: Ratio of operating net debt to operating EBITDA.
kpis.description: Operating leverage improved from 1.8x to 1.5x, a sign of strengthened financial solidity and better debt-bearing capacity.

kpis.name: Total assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €1.6B in latest year

kpis.name: Total debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €0.91B in latest year

kpis.name: EHPAD occupancy rate France
kpis.explanation: Percentage of beds occupied in retirement homes in France.
kpis.description: EHPAD occupancy rate in France remained at 94.1% in 2024, above sector average and reflecting excellent alignment of supply with resident and family needs.
kpis.signal: High occupancy rate at 94.1% despite tariff pressure

kpis.name: Number of home hospitalization patients
kpis.explanation: Total number of patients followed in home hospitalization.
kpis.description: HAD patient count rose from 869 to 1,083 in 2024, driven by the acquisition of HAD Saint-Sauveur in June 2024 and growing demand for proximity care.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or advanced digital technologies in the provided documents. LNA Santé does not position AI as a strategic lever.
evidence: No reference to AI, machine learning or digital health in the text
Absence of KPIs tied to technological innovation or APIs
Strategy centered on human touch, care delivery and physical facility upgrades
